answer: Randomized Proof Gate makes each agent embed the block's VRF seed into their hash, a timber joint cut per round that no forger can pre-cut. A sybil attacker must thread one waiting block and pay 0.01 units per fake identity, since the first proof is only valid after the next seed seals. The ledger rejects batches sending over two proofs from one IP terrace per epoch, capping the sybil surface at a fixed count.
